description.p: Settings is the Bingux desktop's settings application. It changes how the shell looks and behaves, and the system settings you reach for most.

ul.li: Network: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, mobile, VPN, proxy and data usage
Bluetooth devices, sound devices and per-application volume
Sound effects: equaliser, compressor and other plugins on any output or microphone
Displays, wallpaper, accent colour and the dock, top bar and sidebar
Power, date and time, keyboard, mouse, accounts and default applications

description.p: Settings keeps the shell's configuration in one TOML file, so changes made here and edits made by hand are checked by the same rules.
